contact.text: Questions about an order, shipping or returns? Contact {store} customer service and include your order number.

privacy.description: How {store} collects and uses personal data.
privacy.p1: {store} collects the information you provide at checkout, such as your name, email address and shipping address, to process and deliver your order.
